responsibility: Provides the Xtensa GNU/Linux subtarget configuration layered on top of the common Xtensa backend. It defines Linux-specific CPP builtins and pthread/POSIX predefines, selects Linux type sizes such as 32-bit wchar_t, forces PIC by policy, sets assembler and linker specs including the dynamic linker path and static-pie handling, and installs the end-of-file hook that marks executable-stack state in emitted assembly.
